### LKQ Corporation to Release Third Quarter 2026 Results on Thursday, October 29, 2026


October 5, 2026


ANTIOCH, Tenn., Oct. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- LKQ Corporation (Nasdaq: LKQ) will release its third quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, October 29, 2026.


**Conference Call Details**


LKQ will host a conference call and webcast on October 29, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time (7:00 a.m. Central Time) with members of senior management to discuss the Company's results. To access the investor conference call, please dial (833) 461-5787. International access to the call may be obtained by dialing (626) 884-3620. The investor conference call will require you to enter conference ID: 778680119.


**Webcast and Presentation Details**


The audio webcast and accompanying slide presentation can be accessed at ([www.lkqcorp.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=KXLvYsFxJAYgR7FNzNqHCHFASzR8poi63PVoei07UFQ8lu2bkMWhq33ucNhbNhMuy1F6VlYciGlJUbcb5IjnK3YiH2GrvFp2xmIJrcRFL2Q=) ) in the Investor Relations section.

**About LKQ Corporation**


LKQ Corporation ([www.lkqcorp.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=KXLvYsFxJAYgR7FNzNqHCM6T_v6Ionk7WifeIU-3i7X04zPG4bJ9z4blPEJn3e06uRXe2D1_yaGfNlEKayaSeA==) ) is a leading provider of alternative and specialty parts to repair and accessorize automobiles and other vehicles. LKQ has operations in North America, Europe and Taiwan. LKQ offers its customers a broad range of OE recycled and aftermarket parts, replacement systems, components, equipment, and services to repair and accessorize automobiles, trucks, and recreational and performance vehicles.
